purpose: Execute one autonomous Muse web asset job for the existing Japanese RV ice-apocalypse demo; process all 13 storyboard IDs and return an editable asset package.
execution_request_vi: Đọc toàn bộ JSON và giải nén inputs trước khi chạy. Thực hiện công việc ngay, tự xử lý đủ 13 ID theo thứ tự. Dùng lại ảnh đã chọn và clip 0001 thành công; tạo 12 clip image-to-video còn thiếu. Không chỉ trả một kế hoạch, không dừng sau cảnh đầu, không hỏi lại giữa các cảnh. Tự lưu checkpoint sau từng cảnh, rồi trả một ZIP tải được cùng bảng trạng thái trung thực.

service_policy.provider: Muse web built-in media tools on the currently signed-in account
service_policy.if_quota_or_account_limit: Checkpoint completed IDs, mark remaining IDs blocked, package partial outputs and report the precise service error. Do not purchase, switch account, schedule retries or silently change provider.

inputs.resolve_relative_paths_against: directory containing extracted inputs/ and context/
inputs.missing_input_handling: Check archive listing and extraction first. If an input is truly missing, mark that ID missing rather than substituting or inventing it; continue independent IDs.

creative_bible.fixed_style_en_exact: Hand-drawn 2D stickman survival illustration, simple white round head with minimal black facial features, thin black stick arms and legs, compact navy blue winter parka, charcoal beanie and gloves, clean bold charcoal outlines, softly textured flat cel colors, cinematic wide composition, atmospheric blue-gray snowbound backgrounds, warm amber cabin light, restrained adult survival tone, consistent cream motorhome with a muted teal horizontal stripe whenever the vehicle is visible, balanced readable silhouettes, no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no text or numerals.
creative_bible.main_character: One solitary adult stickman, white round head, minimal black face, thin black limbs, navy parka, charcoal beanie, gloves. No mother, family, companion or pet.
creative_bible.rv: Cream motorhome, one main muted teal horizontal stripe, exactly two rectangular roof solar panels; preserve side entrance, windows, wheelbase, cabin and interior layout from the supplied scene images. Do not mirror, redesign or drive the RV unless the scene explicitly requires it.
creative_bible.environment: Frozen-apocalypse northern city, cold blue-gray exteriors, warm amber RV interior; mature restrained 2D survival illustration.
creative_bible.human_count_rule: One protagonist. Only scene-specific incidental bystanders already visible in IDs 0009, 0010, 0012 and 0013 are allowed. They never become travel companions.
creative_bible.text_rule: No text, digits, day labels, captions, logo, badge, national emblem, flag or watermark baked into stills or clips. All Japanese captions and day labels remain a later local Remotion overlay.
creative_bible.time_rule: Retain the existing hook, day-19 flash-forward, then day-1 flashback. Do not make all scenes show the same snow depth or invent new story beats.
creative_bible.camera_rule: Locked-off camera in newly generated clips. Environmental and action motion only. Scene 0001 is an explicitly preserved pilot exception with a reported strong push-in warning.

execution.idempotency: Before each ID, check progress and the actual image/video file. Reuse verified successful output; do not charge another generation for a completed ID. An acknowledgement or running task is not a completed video.
execution.continuation: Continue automatically to the next ID after each success or scene-specific failure. Do not stop after the first scene, ask the user to paste the next prompt, or require approval after each ID.
execution.global_blocker: On an account-wide quota, availability or policy error, stop further generation calls, preserve completed work and package partial results. An old account's restriction is historical and is not evidence that the current account is blocked.
execution.if_turn_time_limit: Write a durable checkpoint and identify exact completed, running and pending IDs. Resume from checkpoint within this same job when supported. Do not invent completed files or create an unsolicited recurring schedule.

workflow.name: preflight
actions: Read the JSON, extract the archive, verify all asset hashes and the exact 13 ordered IDs.
Create output directories plus progress.json/results.json. Verify that the provided 0001 MP4 is a valid existing 10-second source.

workflow.name: lock_existing_story_and_timing
actions: Treat the 13 Japanese storyboard blocks, 26 display-caption pages and 2571-frame local timeline as read-only context.
Do not recreate OmniVoice, ASR, SRT, captions, music or the final episode. Source clips are 10 seconds, while local edit durations remain the per-scene locked frame counts.

workflow.name: select_still_per_id
actions: Reuse each supplied scene still; convert 0001 WEBP to PNG without redrawing when writing images/0001.png.
Keep the exact original English prompt per storyboard ID as provenance; each prompt ends with the unchanged fixed style.
Do not generate extra stills, split blocks, merge IDs, create collages or redraw already successful supplied images.

workflow.name: image_to_video_per_id
actions: Reuse provided 0001-silent.mp4. For IDs 0002 through 0013, call built-in image-to-video using that ID's supplied image and its complete motion prompt.
Request 10 seconds, landscape 16:9, silent, and locked-off framing. Preserve the scene's geometry and character counts.
Wait for the real generation result and save it before moving on. No code-generated still-image pan/zoom substitute for a failed image-to-video call.

workflow.name: media_qc_and_silent_delivery
actions: Inspect actual files using available media tools: decode, duration, resolution, frame rate and audio streams. Record actual native dimensions; do not label an upscale as native 1080p.
Preserve the raw generated MP4. If it contains any audio stream, remove audio by lossless remux/video-stream copy into videos/ID.mp4. This audio removal is permitted code processing.
Do not crop, upscale, interpolate frames, retime or otherwise re-encode picture merely to satisfy metadata. Record a near-16:9 output honestly for the local editor to handle.
Visually inspect beginning, middle and end for identity, vehicle geometry, unexpected people, camera motion, text and action continuity. Mark creative warnings without spending another generation.
If duration is not 10 seconds, mark needs_review with the measured duration. Do not slow the clip, loop frames, freeze or invent missing seconds.

workflow.name: checkpoint_and_continue
actions: After each ID, update progress.json and results.json with exact paths, measured properties, source tool result and any errors or warnings.
Continue until all 13 IDs have a final status or a documented account-wide blocker stops the batch.

workflow.name: package_and_report
actions: Return rv-ice-ja-demo-muse-assets-v1.zip containing images/, videos/, raw_videos/, results.json, progress.json, this workflow JSON, locked context and a concise Vietnamese QA report.
Also expose results.json as a separate downloadable attachment and a contact sheet if practical.
State actual completed/failed/pending counts and unresolved creative warnings; never call a partial batch fully complete.

workflow.name: handoff_to_local_remotion
actions: Leave local final assembly to the existing Remotion project. Do not claim to have changed files on the user's Windows machine.

The local editor will trim each 10-second source at playbackRate=1 to the original frame duration, fit into 1920x1080 at 30fps, and retain the existing Japanese narration/captions/ambience/SFX unchanged.

output_contract.videos: videos/0001.mp4 through videos/0013.mp4, with no audio streams
output_contract.raw_videos: Unmodified generated source clips, where available
